note: Hand-written, never regenerated (docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-14-squirtle-squad-design.md). A Special variant is a one-of-a-kind Variant of a species a player wins (ownable: true). An entry with ownable: false is a look a computer-run Trainer's Pokémon can wear: sprites only, never owned. baseStats replace the species' in battle; extraMoves are learnable from Lv 1; startLevel is the Level a won copy starts at. Sprites: public/sprites/pokemon/special/{normal,grayscale}/<key>.gif.
